facts.text: She has a house of her own that she calls large; the record gives no address, no district and no rooms beyond those below.
She cooks there when she has someone to feed and keeps food in the house; the evening meal is between seven and eight.
Her own room has a bed and a table; the table is where her manuscript lies, and she sits on the bed with photographs.
She says it is a little hard to write at home and she concentrates better in the club room.
She sends a handwritten manuscript by fax when time is short.
The literary club room is where she has sat with 一悟 and 真優 nearly every day since April.
She goes to the library to research and to work, and stays until the light goes.
She buys from the school shop, and 真里亜 brings club treats from it.
She comes to school by bicycle and says so when offered a lift on foot.
Once she says she will go home by car with 百花.

week.text: School days she is in the club room with the club.
She works in the library on her novel or on research.
Some nights a deadline keeps her up and she arrives sleepy.
At home she writes at her table and eats between seven and eight.

visit.text: On the club's overnight she sleeps in the same room as the others and tells them to turn in once the teacher has come; she asks when 真里亜 will bathe so the baths can be shared out.
